text_block_list.text:
Ever since that day,
I started seeing Tanino Gimlet
training with fierce dedication once
again.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah, hah, hah!
—Even the Sun God has retreated to his
eastern palace...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh...
Then I shall become the Goddess of the
Moon! Race across the nocturnal sky,
and loose an arrow of moonlight upon the
turf...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaahhhhhhh—!!

After speaking with her the other day,
I finally understood.
At first glance,
Tanino Gimlet just seems deeply lost in her
own grand worldview, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—...In short, ever since that fateful day,
I have honed my strength and speed upon the
foundation of fleeting,
dazzling brilliance.

She charges straight ahead to become the
self she has dreamed of since childhood,
a tireless worker striving to seize the
glorious crowns she encounters along the
way.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Heh-heh! Ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Run... Run,
run! It is far too early for the serene
slumber of the abyss...!!
Haaah-hah-hah-hah-hah!!

What kind of spectacle would a horsegirl
with such conviction put on
in a medium-distance mock race?
My anticipation grew with every passing
day...!
—And then came the day of the mock race.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Today's medium-distance mock race should
be interesting.
I hear Symboli Kris S is running.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet is in it too,
right after running that mile race.
Impressive that she adjusted her condition
in such a short window.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Her performance in the mile was remarkable,
sure... But at this distance,
who knows?
It's going to demand serious stamina.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Is she testing out a mock MC rotation or
something? If she pulls off a result here,
she's an extraordinary talent. But... well,
you know.

A doubtful murmur rippled through the
gossiping trainers,
as if expecting it to be impossible, but—
choice_data_list: (No, if anyone can handle this dis...

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because I had watched her so closely
lately...
before I knew it,
my anticipation had turned into a prayer.

—At long last,
the highly anticipated mock race began.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And they're off!
Tanino Gimlet settles into the middle of
the pack.

Symboli Kris S holds a spot in the forward-mid
pack while Tanino Gimlet
bides her time toward the rear-mid,
steadily pacing herself through the race.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(I will not repeat history!
I refuse to succumb to eternal
recurrence—!)

As if navigating around the troubles of her
last race,
Tanino Gimlet begins easing out wide as she
rounds the fourth corner!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet sweeps wide from the midfield,
surging toward a prime position!
She breaks through the fourth corner and
enters the home stretch!

There is no wall ahead to obstruct her.
A smirk graces her lips. Her eyes ignite,
her legs drive deep into the ground, and—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaahhhhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Flying up from the outside with incredible
momentum! It's Symboli Kris S—
and Tanino Gimlet! Under 200 meters to go!

While the lead pack led by Symboli Kris S
duels on the inside,
Tanino Gimlet unleashes a ferocious late
surge—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Wh-What?!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Coming on the outside,
it's Tanino Gimlet! Tanino Gimlet!
Tanino Gimlet breaks clear—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: And crosses the wire!

She claimed a spectacular first-place
victory!

—The genius speed I witnessed the other
day.
And today,
she demonstrated stamina and power fully
equal to it.

Even without a trainer by her side,
she has come closer than anyone to
conquering the MC rotation—
a feat impossible without relentless effort
and overwhelming genius.

The pinnacle of modern aesthetics:
conquering the MC rotation.
If I walk this path alongside her,
it's no mere pipe dream...!

Casting all restraint aside,
I bolted from the stands and rushed toward
her.
Before I realized it,
rain had begun to fall over the turf.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—... The heavens weep.
Weeping in ecstatic joy over my
triumph...!
Heh-heh! Ahhahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: So you have come. And—... Oho.

Turning around at the sound of my voice,
Tanino Gimlet peered intently into my face
with a knowing smirk.
choice_data_list: I really want to be your trainer—
I want to be your trainer after all—

text_block_list.text:
Before I could finish my sentence,
she took my right hand...
and gently pressed my wrist against her
ear.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
............
—Heh... The verdict has been handed down.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations.
You possess the talent to be thoroughly
intoxicated by me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Examine yourself.
What else could you possibly call this
state?

...Suddenly,
I noticed the heat pulsing in the palm of
my hand.
My heart was pounding, and my face—no,
my entire body was burning up.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A racing pulse, an elevated temperature—
and a second trainer request made with all
reason cast to the wind.
All because you drank in the unfiltered
essence of Tanino Gimlet—am I wrong?

Whether you'd call this "intoxication" or
not—
there was no question that this sheer
exhilaration was all her doing.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...—The ideal form I envision for myself
is a fleeting brilliance that intoxicates
the world—its very incarnation.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then naturally,
the one serving as my closest confidant—
my trainer—
must be the most deeply intoxicated of
all...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My trainer must, of course,
possess the supreme talent to be drunk on
me above all others!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Had your pulse failed to quicken by even a
single beat,
...I would have rejected you a second time
right here and now. Which means—

I suddenly remembered the words Tanino Gimlet
had said before.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Then there is only one thing left to do.
I shall give you a twist."

All those theatrical displays up until now
might have been a prelude—
a test to determine if I was a trainer
capable of being truly captivated by her.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh...! If you understand,
then accept it with reverence.
You are now Tanino Gimlet's dedicated
trainer!

With that,
she suddenly reached a hand toward the
sky.
She lightly twisted her fingertips,
as if grasping a cocktail glass.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, behold!
A toast to this boundless sky!
May supreme destruction and bitters bless
our long journey...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —It is still far too early for a gimlet.

She tipped the invisible glass gently toward
the heavens. As I followed her gaze,
almost as if it were part of her staging—

A magnificent rainbow stretched across the
sky.
